 Applications 
 
 Interact with your customers on the channel of their choice with the most trusted platforms for marketing, customer service and more. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Messaging platform 
 
 
 Sinch Engage is a multichannel campaign platform that helps users interact, engage and retain customers via SMS/MMS, RCS and WhatsApp. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Email marketing 
 
 
 With Sinch Mailjet, you can effotlessly design, send and measure email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and automated communications. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Chatbot builder 
 
 
 Sinch Chatlayer is a conversational AI platform for creating chat and voice bots, enabling 24/7 customer engagement in 125+ languages across multiple channels. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Contact center 
 
 
 Sinch Contact Pro is a CCaaS for omnichannel communication. It integrates with major CRMs, handles high volumes, ensures security, and provides analytics. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 APIs 
 
 Build the exact setup you need to communicate with customers on their favorite channels with flexible APIs.

 Email 
 
 
 
 Send 
 
 
 Send, recieve, and track with confidence using the most powerful email APIs in the industry, backed by security and compliance standards you won't find elsewhere.

 Optimize 
 
 
 Apply strategic best practices at every stage of your email sending journey to maximize inbox placement and improve email ROI.

 Numbers 
 
 
 
 10DLC 
 
 
 A2P messaging solution using local 10-digit numbers for text, MMS, and voice. Cost-effective, high throughput, and better deliverability for expanding reach and boosting engagement. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Virtual long numbers 
 
 
 Use local numbers for global two-way messaging, boosting response rates. Cost-effective and quick to set up. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Toll-free numbers 
 
 
 Enable two-way messaging with toll-free numbers, supporting customer communication across the U.S. and Canada. Text-enable existing numbers without affecting voice services. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Short codes 
 
 
 Reach large audiences with recognizable short codes for SMS and MMS campaigns. Build trust, track performance, and stay compliant with industry regulations. 
 
Learn more

 Fax API 
 
 
 Securely send and receive faxes at scale with Sinch's HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 1, and GDPR compliant fax API. 
 
Learn more

 Bring Your Own Carrier 
 
 
 
 Direct routing for Microsoft Teams 
 
 
 Direct Routing allows Microsoft Teams to make and receive external calls within the platform. It optimizes Microsoft licensing to help enterprises save costs by enabling calling for individual users rather than the entire organization. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Operator connect for Microsoft Teams 
 
 
 Turn Teams into a primary phone system with full PSTN connectivity, allowing calls to anyone, anywhere, with E911 services. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Cloud connect for Webex calling 
 
 
 Enable PSTN calling for Webex Calling Dedicated Instance. Enjoy clear calls, HD video, and unified messaging in one platform. Boost productivity and cut costs. 
 
Learn more

 E911 
 
 
 Ensure fast, reliable, and accurate E911 call delivery, complying with Kari's Law and RAY BAUM'S Act.

 Migrate your legacy infrastructure to next generation 911 and enable callers to communicate to responders via voice, text, data and video.

 Enterprise revenue maximization

 A2P monetization 
 
 
 Helping operators optimize A2P revenues and costs, providing commercial advantages. Includes Sentinel tool for detecting bypass fraud and voice verification monetization. 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Signaling firewall 
 
 
 Protect your network from complex threat scenarios with Sinch's cross-protocol signaling firewall, mitigating attacks and securing your infrastructure. 
 
Learn more
